elements.title: Figure 11.—Change in U.S. Consumption of Nonfuel Mineral Commodities From 2022 to 2023
elements.content:
Chart kind: Vertical bar chart
Y-axis: Percent change, range from -100 to 100
X-axis: Nonfuel mineral commodity (listed below, rotated vertical)
Legend: 
- Blue bars: Critical minerals
- Orange bars: Other minerals
